title: Ordering at a coffee shop

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Hi there. What can I get for you?
lines.zh: 嗨，您要来点什么？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Can I get a medium latte, please?
lines.zh: 请给我一杯中杯拿铁。

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Sure. Do you want that hot or iced?
lines.zh: 好的。要热的还是冰的？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Hot, please. And could I get oat milk?
lines.zh: 热的，谢谢。能不能换成燕麦奶？

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Yeah, we can do that. Anything else today?
lines.zh: 可以。今天还要别的吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I'm good. Just the coffee.
lines.zh: 不用了，只要咖啡。

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Okay. That's five fifty. Can I get a name for the cup?
lines.zh: 好。一共五块五。杯子上写什么名字？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Maya. Do you take cards?
lines.zh: Maya。可以刷卡吗？

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: We do. You can tap it right here.
lines.zh: 可以。在这儿轻轻一碰就行。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Great. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: 太好了，谢谢。

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: You got it. It'll be ready in a minute.
lines.zh: 不客气。马上就好。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I'll wait over there.
lines.zh: 我在那边等。

lines.speaker: Barista
lines.text: Maya? Here's your latte. Have a good one.
lines.zh: Maya？您的拿铁好了。祝您今天愉快。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thank you. You too.
lines.zh: 谢谢，你也是。

whereZh: 上班路上的一家小咖啡馆，柜台前排着几个人。

sounds.title: can I / want that
sounds.note: What can I get 里的 can 会说得很轻，几乎像 kn。不要每个词都用力念满。
sounds.example: What can I get for you?

sounds.title: please / fifty
sounds.note: fifty 里的 i 是短而松的 /ɪ/，不要说成 fee-ty。和 please 的长 /iː/ 对比着听。
sounds.example: That's five fifty.

roles.name: Barista
roles.goalZh: 问清楚需求，报价格，写名字。

variations.setupZh: 你刚点了燕麦拿铁，店员告诉你燕麦奶没有了。
variations.cue: Sorry, we're out of oat milk. We still have regular or almond.
variations.cueZh: 不好意思，燕麦奶卖完了。还剩下普通牛奶和杏仁奶。
hints: Almond is fine.
Then just regular milk, please.
In that case, can I get a black coffee?

variations.setupZh: 杯子做好了，但店员叫的不是你的名字。
variations.cue: Maria? I have a hot latte for Maria.
variations.cueZh: Maria？这有一杯热拿铁是给 Maria 的。
hints: I think that's mine. It's Maya.
That's for me. The name is Maya.
Sorry, I think you meant Maya.

variations.setupZh: 店里人多，店员说得又快又轻。
variations.cue: Want that for here or to go? We can bring it over if you're staying.
variations.cueZh: 在店里喝还是带走？如果坐着，我们可以给您送到座位。
hints: To go, please.
For here, thanks.
Sorry, could you say that again?

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你进了哪家店、点了什么、中间有没有改决定、最后怎么付钱的。

phrases.text: What can I get for you?
phrases.note: 店员的常用开场，比 What do you want 客气。

phrases.text: Can I get a medium latte, please?
phrases.note: 点单最稳妥的句式：Can I get + 规格 + 饮品。

phrases.text: Do you want that hot or iced?
phrases.note: 店员确认规格时用，你也可以主动先说。

phrases.text: Could I get oat milk?
phrases.note: 更换配料时用 Could I get，比 I want 软。

phrases.text: I'm good. Just the coffee.
Do you take cards?
It'll be ready in a minute.
phrases.note: 店员告诉你稍等一会儿。

phrases.text: Have a good one.
phrases.note: 道别时很口语的一句，不必回得太长。

whoZh: 你是 Maya，对面是店员。
goalZh: 点一杯你常喝的咖啡，说清楚热的还是冰的、要哪种奶，再顺利结账。
gistZh: 玛雅在咖啡馆点了一杯热的中杯燕麦拿铁，店员问了规格和名字，很快就做好了。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say where you were, what you asked for, and how you paid.

title: Dinner at a restaurant

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Hi, welcome. How many in your party?
lines.zh: 您好，欢迎。几位？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Just me tonight. Could I sit by the window?
lines.zh: 今晚就我一个。可以坐窗户边吗？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Of course. Right this way. Here's the menu.
lines.zh: 当然。请这边走。这是菜单。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Thanks. What's good here?
lines.zh: 谢谢。这儿有什么值得点的？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: The roast chicken is really popular tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚的烤鸡很受欢迎。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I'll go with that. And a small soup, please.
lines.zh: 那就这个。再来一份小份的汤。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Any allergies I should know about?
lines.zh: 有什么过敏的吗，我需要知道一下？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: No allergies, but can I get that without onions?
lines.zh: 不过敏，不过能不能不要洋葱？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: No problem. I'll put that in. Anything to drink?
lines.zh: 没问题，我给您写上。喝点什么？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Just water is fine.
lines.zh: 清水就好。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Got it. I'll be back with your water.
lines.zh: 好的。我先把水给您送来。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: This is great, thank you. Can I get the check when you have a minute?
lines.zh: 很好吃，谢谢。你方便的时候把账单拿过来好吗？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Here you go. You can pay up front whenever you're ready.
lines.zh: 给您。准备好了可以去前面付。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Thanks. I'll take care of it now.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我现在就去付。

whereZh: 一家不太吵的晚饭馆，你们刚坐下。

sounds.title: welcome / water / whenever
sounds.note: welcome、water、whenever 的开头是圆唇的 /w/，两唇收圆，不要用上齿咬下唇。
sounds.example: You can pay up front whenever you're ready.

sounds.title: sit by / without onions
sounds.note: sit by the window、without onions 里，前一个词的尾音会连到下一个词的开头，听起来像一个词。
sounds.example: Can I get that without onions?

variations.setupZh: 你点了烤鸡，服务员回来说今晚没有了。
variations.cue: I'm sorry, we're out of the roast chicken. The fish is really good too.
variations.cueZh: 不好意思，烤鸡卖完了。鱼也很好吃。
hints: Then I'll have the fish, please.
What else would you recommend?
Okay, I'll go with the soup and a salad.

variations.setupZh: 端上来的不是你点的，里面还有洋葱。
variations.cue: Here's your chicken. Enjoy.
variations.cueZh: 这是您的鸡。请慢用。
hints: Sorry, I asked for no onions.
I think this might be the wrong dish.
Could I get this without onions, please?

variations.setupZh: 服务员一边收拾一边很快地问你要怎么付。
variations.cue: You want to split this, or is it all together? We take cards or cash.
variations.cueZh: 是分开付还是一起付？卡和现金都行。
hints: All together, please. I'll pay by card.
It's just me, so all together.
Sorry, could you say that a little slower?

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你进了哪家馆子、坐在哪儿、点了什么、有没有改过菜、最后怎么买的单。

phrases.text: How many in your party?
Could I sit by the window?
What's good here?
phrases.note: 请店员给一个轻松的推荐。

phrases.text: I'll go with that.
phrases.note: 已经决定了，指着推荐或菜单说。

phrases.text: Can I get that without onions?
phrases.note: 改配料的固定说法，换别的配料也一样。

phrases.text: Just water is fine.
Can I get the check when you have a minute?
phrases.zh: 你方便时把账单拿过来好吗？
phrases.note: 买单时比 Check, please 更软一点。

phrases.text: I'll take care of it now.
phrases.note: 表示自己来付钱或来办这件事。

whoZh: 你是 Leo，对面是服务员 Nina。
goalZh: 要到位子、点好菜、说清忌口，最后顺利买单。
gistZh: 利奥要了一张两人桌，点了烤鸡和汤，说明不要洋葱，最后把账买了。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say where you sat, what you ordered, and how you paid.

title: Checking out at the store

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Excuse me, do you know where the oat milk is?
lines.zh: 不好意思，请问燕麦奶在哪里？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Yeah, it's in aisle four, near the regular milk.
lines.zh: 在第四过道，普通牛奶旁边。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Aisle four. Thanks a lot.
lines.zh: 第四过道。谢谢。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: No problem. Let me know if you can't find it.
lines.zh: 不客气。找不到再叫我。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Found it. I can check out here, right?
lines.zh: 找到了。可以在这儿结账吧？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Yep. Did you find everything okay?
lines.zh: 对。东西都找到了吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I did, thanks. Could I get a bag, please?
lines.zh: 找到了，谢谢。能给我一个袋子吗？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Sure. Paper or plastic?
lines.zh: 可以。纸袋还是塑料袋？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Paper, please. And can I pay with my phone?
lines.zh: 纸袋，谢谢。可以用手机付吗？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: You can. Just hold it over the reader.
lines.zh: 可以。把手机放在感应区上就行。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay, done. Do I need a receipt?
lines.zh: 好了。要小票吗？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I can print one if you want. Or I can email it.
lines.zh: 要的话我可以打印，也可以发到邮箱。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Email is fine. Thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 发邮箱就好。谢谢你的帮助。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Have a nice day.
lines.zh: 祝你今天愉快。

whereZh: 社区超市的收银台前，你篮子里有几样日常用品。

sounds.title: aisle / bag
sounds.note: aisle 是双元音 /aɪ/，嘴要从开口滑到 /ɪ/。bag 是扁唇短 /æ/，嘴张开但不滑动。
sounds.example: It's in aisle four.

sounds.title: find it / get a bag
sounds.note: find it、get a bag 会连在一起。a 常常弱读成很轻的 /ə/。
sounds.example: Could I get a bag, please?

variations.setupZh: 你走到第四过道，货架是空的。店员走过来。
variations.cue: Yeah, we sold out of that this morning. We should get more tomorrow.
variations.cueZh: 对，今早卖完了。明天应该会再进。
hints: Okay, I'll come back tomorrow.
Do you have something similar?
Thanks, I'll skip it today.

variations.setupZh: 结账时店员很快问你有没有会员卡。
variations.cue: Do you have a store card? You'd save two dollars today.
variations.cueZh: 您有会员卡吗？今天能省两块钱。
hints: I don't, thanks. I'll just pay.
Not with me. Can I still check out?
Sorry, I don't have one.

variations.setupZh: 你付完钱后发现袋子里多了一瓶水，小票上却没有。
variations.cue: Is everything okay?
variations.cueZh: 有什么问题吗？
hints: I think this water wasn't on the bill.
Could you add this, please?
Sorry, I grabbed this by mistake.

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你去超市找什么、怎么问路、结账时说了哪几句。

phrases.text: Excuse me, do you know where the oat milk is?
phrases.zh: 不好意思，请问燕麦奶在哪里？

phrases.text: It's in aisle four, near the regular milk.
phrases.zh: 在第四过道，普通牛奶旁边。
phrases.note: 听位置时抓住过道号和旁边是什么。

phrases.text: Did you find everything okay?
phrases.note: 收银员常问的一句，用来补买漏掉的东西。

phrases.text: Could I get a bag, please?
Can I pay with my phone?
phrases.note: 现在很常见，比只问卡更准确。

phrases.text: Just hold it over the reader.
phrases.zh: 把手机放在感应区上就行。

phrases.text: Email is fine.
Thanks for your help.
phrases.note: 结束时比单独说 Thanks 更完整。

whoZh: 你是 Maya，对面是收银员 Sam。
goalZh: 找到一样找不到的东西，顺利结账，必要时补一句小请求。
gistZh: 玛雅向店员打听燕麦奶在哪，结账时加了一包袋子，并用手机付了钱。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say what you were looking for, how you asked, and how you paid.

title: Returning an item

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hi, how can I help you today?
lines.zh: 您好，今天有什么可以帮您？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Hi. I bought this charger last week, but it doesn't work.
lines.zh: 嗨。这个充电器我上周买的，但是不能用。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?
lines.zh: 真抱歉。您有小票吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Yes, it's on my phone. Here it is.
lines.zh: 有，在手机里。给您看。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Thanks. Did you want to exchange it, or would you like a refund?
lines.zh: 谢谢。您是想换一个，还是想退款？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: A refund would be better, if that's okay.
lines.zh: 如果可以的话，退款更好。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: That's fine. I can put it back on the same card.
lines.zh: 可以。我会退回到原来那张卡上。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: How long does that usually take?
lines.zh: 一般要多久能到账？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: It should show up in three to five days.
lines.zh: 一般三到五天就能看到。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Okay, that works. Do I need to sign anything?
lines.zh: 好，可以。还要签字吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Just here, please. And I'll give you a copy.
lines.zh: 在这儿签一下就行。我会给您一份单子。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Thanks for taking care of this.
lines.zh: 谢谢你帮我处理。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Of course. Sorry again for the trouble.
lines.zh: 应该的。再次为给您添麻烦说声抱歉。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: It's all right. Have a good day.
lines.zh: 没关系。祝你今天愉快。

whereZh: 商店的退换柜台前，你手里拿着一个包装盒。

sounds.title: this / thanks / three
sounds.note: this、thanks、three 的 th 是舌尖放在齿间，不要用中文的「斯」。
sounds.example: It should show up in three to five days.

sounds.title: would you / does that
sounds.note: would you like、does that usually take 里，would、does、that 都会变轻。抓住后面的实词。
sounds.example: How long does that usually take?

variations.setupZh: 店员查了日期，发现已经超过普通退货期。
variations.cue: This is past the return window, but I can still exchange it if you want.
variations.cueZh: 已经过了退货期，但如果您愿意，我还可以给您换一个。
hints: An exchange is fine, thank you.
Is there anything else you can do?
Okay, I'll take the exchange.

variations.setupZh: 店员问你盒子和配件是否还在。
variations.cue: Do you still have the box and the cable that came with it?
variations.cueZh: 盒子和原来的线还在吗？
hints: Yes, I have everything here.
I have the box, but not the bag.
Sorry, I already threw the box away.

variations.setupZh: 店员很快地念了一遍退款规则。
variations.cue: Refunds go back to the original payment method and may take up to a week, depending on your bank.
variations.cueZh: 退款会退回原支付方式，取决于银行，可能要一周。
hints: Okay, I understand.
Sorry, could you say that again?
So it might take a week?

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你退了什么、问题是什么、店员怎么处理、钱什么时候到。

phrases.text: How can I help you today?
phrases.note: 柜台和服务窗口最常见的开场。

phrases.text: I bought this charger last week, but it doesn't work.
phrases.zh: 这个充电器我上周买的，但是不能用。
phrases.note: 先说买了什么、再说明问题。

phrases.text: Do you have the receipt?
phrases.note: 退货时几乎一定会被问到。

phrases.text: Did you want to exchange it, or would you like a refund?
phrases.zh: 您是想换一个，还是想退款？

phrases.text: A refund would be better, if that's okay.
phrases.zh: 如果可以的话，退款更好。

phrases.text: How long does that usually take?
That works.
Thanks for taking care of this.
phrases.zh: 谢谢你帮我处理这件事。
phrases.note: 事情办完后的一句收尾。

whoZh: 你是 Leo，对面是店员 Amy。
goalZh: 把问题说清楚，礼貌地要求退货或换货，并问清退款怎么到账。
gistZh: 利奥带回一个有问题的充电器，店员核对小票后给他办理了退款。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say what you brought back, what was wrong, and how they helped you.

title: Asking for directions

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Excuse me, sorry to bother you. Is the Park Street station near here?
lines.zh: 不好意思，打扰一下。公园街地铁站离这儿近吗？

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: Yeah, it's not far. You're going the right way.
lines.zh: 近，不远。你现在走的方向是对的。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Oh, good. How far is it from here?
lines.zh: 那就好。离这儿还有多远？

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: About eight minutes on foot. Keep going straight down this street.
lines.zh: 走路大概八分钟。沿着这条街一直往前走。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Straight down this street. Then what?
lines.zh: 沿这条街一直走。然后呢？

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: When you get to the light, turn left. You'll see the entrance on your right.
lines.zh: 到红绿灯后左转。入口就在你右手边。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: So, left at the light, and the entrance is on the right.
lines.zh: 也就是说，红绿灯左转，入口在右边。

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: That's it. You can't miss it.
lines.zh: 对，很好找。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Is there a bus I could take instead?
lines.zh: 有没有公交车可以坐？

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: There is, but walking is faster from here.
lines.zh: 有，不过从这儿走路还更快。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Got it. Thanks so much for your help.
lines.zh: 明白了。非常感谢你的帮助。

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: No problem. Have a good one.
lines.zh: 不客气。走好。

whereZh: 一个陌生街区的街口，你要去公园地铁站。

sounds.title: right / light / street
sounds.note: right 和 light 只差一个音。/r/ 舌尖不要抵牙，舌头向后收；/l/ 舌尖抵上牙龈。straight、street 也要听清 /r/。
sounds.example: When you get to the light, turn left.

sounds.title: turn left / on your right
sounds.note: turn left、on your right 会连起来。your 常常弱读。
sounds.example: You'll see the entrance on your right.

variations.setupZh: 你问完后，路人想了一下，并不是很有把握。
variations.cue: I think it's that way, but I'm not from around here. You might want to check your map.
variations.cueZh: 我感觉是那边，不过我不是本地的。你最好再看一下地图。
hints: Okay, thanks anyway.
I'll check my map. Thanks.
Do you know if it's close, at least?

variations.setupZh: 街上有车经过，你漏掉了关键的一句。
variations.cue: Go past the little park and then take the second right.
variations.cueZh: 走过那个小公园，然后在第二个路口右转。
hints: Sorry, I missed that. Could you say it again?
Was it the first right or the second?
Past the park, then the second right?

variations.setupZh: 路人以为你很熟，说得又快又简。

lines.zh: 当然。旅途愉快。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: You too. It was nice talking with you.
lines.zh: 你也是。跟你聊得很愉快。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: You too. Take care.
lines.zh: 我也是。保重。

whereZh: 火车或飞机上，邻座的人自然地聊了几句。

sounds.title: see / this / trip
sounds.note: see、nice 偏长；this、trip、it 是短松的 /ɪ/。不要把 trip 说成 treep。
sounds.example: I'm going to see a friend for the weekend.

sounds.title: this / that / three
sounds.note: this、that、three hours 的 th 要露舌尖，轻而清楚。
sounds.example: About three hours. It's not too bad.

roles.name: Leo
roles.goalZh: 应对闲聊并在合适时收束。

variations.setupZh: 邻座对你的行程感兴趣，多问了一句。
variations.cue: Oh, nice. What's your friend like? Have you been there before?
variations.cueZh: 真好。你朋友是什么样的人？你以前去过那儿吗？
hints: We've been friends for years. It's my second visit.
Yes, I went last year. It's a quiet town.
He's an old coworker. I'm excited to see him.

variations.setupZh: 你其实想看书，但对方还在聊。
variations.cue: So, do you travel a lot for work too?
variations.cueZh: 那你工作也经常出差吗？
hints: A little. I might read for a bit, if that's okay.
Not too much. I think I'll rest my eyes too.
Sometimes. Anyway, enjoy your rest.

variations.setupZh: 列车广播响起，对方很快说了一句要下车。
variations.cue: Oh, this is my stop already. Nice talking with you, take care, bye!
variations.cueZh: 哎呀，我已经到站了。聊得很高兴，保重，再见！
hints: Bye, take care!
Nice talking with you too!
Have a good one!

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你在旅途中和谁聊了几句、聊了什么、后来怎么结束的。

phrases.text: Are you heading home, or going somewhere new?
phrases.zh: 你是要回家，还是去一个新地方？

phrases.text: I'm going to see a friend for the weekend.
What about you?
phrases.note: 把话传回去，对话才不会停。

phrases.text: That must be tiring.
phrases.note: 先接住对方的感受，再往下问。

phrases.text: It's not too bad.
It's much better than driving.
I might close my eyes for a bit.
phrases.zh: 我可能闭眼休息一会儿。

phrases.text: It was nice talking with you.

whoZh: 你是 Leo，邻座是 Nina。
goalZh: 用简单的话聊行程，保持礼貌，也能自然结束对话。
gistZh: 利奥和邻座简单聊了从哪来、去哪、天气和旅途，气氛轻松，最后各自休息。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say who you talked to on the trip and how the chat ended.

title: At the doctor's office

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Hi Maya. What brings you in today?
lines.zh: 嗨，Maya。今天哪里不舒服？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: My shoulder has been really tight, and I haven't been sleeping well.
lines.zh: 我的肩膀一直很紧，觉也睡不好。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. How long has this been going on?
lines.zh: 听你这么说挺抱歉的。这样多久了？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: About two weeks. It gets worse at night.
lines.zh: 大概两周了。晚上会更厉害。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Have you tried anything for it?
lines.zh: 你有没有试过什么办法？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Just rest, and I used a warm towel a few times.
lines.zh: 就是休息，还热敷过几次。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's a good start. Do you sit at a desk most of the day?
lines.zh: 这是个好的开始。你是不是白天大部分时间都坐在桌前？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes, I work on a computer. I probably sit too long.
lines.zh: 是，我做电脑前的工作。可能坐得太久了。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That can do it. I'll show you a few simple stretches, and I want you to keep using heat.
lines.zh: 这确实会这样。我教你几个简单的拉伸，热敷也请继续。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay. Should I take any medicine?
lines.zh: 好。需要吃药吗？

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Not yet. If it's not better in a week, come back and we'll look again.
lines.zh: 先不用。如果一周还没好转，再过来，我们再看看。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Got it. Thanks, doctor.
lines.zh: 明白了。谢谢医生。

whereZh: 社区诊所的诊室里，你因为睡眠不好或肩膀酸来看病。

sounds.title: has / hasn't / sleeping
sounds.note: has been、hasn't 的 s 有时是浊音 /z/。sleeping、stretches 里要听清 s。
sounds.example: I haven't been sleeping well.

sounds.title: sleep / sit / week
sounds.titleZh: 长短 i 在病症描述里
sounds.note: sleep、week 偏长；sit、it、this 是短音。不要把 sit 拉成 seat。
sounds.example: Do you sit at a desk most of the day?

roles.name: Alex
roles.goalZh: 了解情况并给出下一步。

variations.setupZh: 医生希望先看一下活动范围。
variations.cue: Can you lift your arm for me? Tell me if it hurts.
variations.cueZh: 请把胳膊抬起来给我看看。如果疼就告诉我。
hints: It hurts a little here.
I can lift it, but not very high.
That's okay, just a bit tight.

variations.setupZh: 医生给了一个生活上的建议。
variations.cue: Try to stand up and walk around every hour, even for two minutes.
variations.cueZh: 尽量每小时站起来走一走，哪怕两分钟也好。
hints: I'll try that.
Every hour, even for two minutes. Okay.
That's helpful, thank you.

variations.setupZh: 医生在写病历的同时快速交代。
variations.cue: Use heat twice a day, avoid heavy bags on that shoulder, and come back if it gets worse or if you feel weak in the arm.
variations.cueZh: 每天热敷两次，那侧肩膀不要扛重包；如果更严重或手臂没力气，就再过来。
hints: Sorry, could you say that a little slower?
Heat twice a day, and come back if it gets worse.
Got it. I'll be careful with bags.

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你哪里不舒服、医生问了什么、你得到了哪些建议。

phrases.text: What brings you in today?
phrases.note: 医生常用的开场，不是在问你为什么来这栋楼。

phrases.text: My shoulder has been really tight.
How long has this been going on?
It gets worse at night.
Have you tried anything for it?
phrases.zh: 你有没有试过什么办法？
phrases.note: 如实说已经做过的即可。

phrases.text: Should I take any medicine?
phrases.note: 不确定时直接问下一步。

phrases.text: If it's not better in a week, come back.
phrases.zh: 如果一周还没好转，再过来。

phrases.text: Got it. Thanks, doctor.

whoZh: 你是 Maya，对面是医生 Alex。
goalZh: 用简单的词说清哪里不舒服、多久了、已经试过什么，并听清下一步。
gistZh: 玛雅说最近肩颈很紧、睡不好，医生问了持续时间和日常习惯，建议先热敷并预约复查。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say what was wrong and what the doctor told you to do.

title: At the pharmacy

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: Hi, what can I do for you?
lines.zh: 您好，有什么可以帮您？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Hi. I need something for a headache, and I've been sleeping badly.
lines.zh: 嗨。我需要一点治头痛的药，而且最近睡得不好。

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: Okay. Have you taken anything already today?
lines.zh: 好。你今天已经吃过什么药了吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Just one pain pill this morning.
lines.zh: 早上只吃过一片止痛药。

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: Are you on any other medicine?
lines.zh: 还在吃别的药吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: No, nothing else.
lines.zh: 没有，没有别的。

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: I can give you this for the pain. Don't take it on an empty stomach.
lines.zh: 止痛我可以给你这个。不要空肚子吃。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Got it. How often can I take it?
lines.zh: 明白。这个多久能吃一次？

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: Every six hours, and no more than three times a day.
lines.zh: 每六小时一次，一天最多三次。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: And for sleep? Is there something gentle I can try?
lines.zh: 那睡觉呢？有没有温和一点的可以试试？

lines.speaker: Jen
lines.text: This tea is mild. Have it thirty minutes before bed. If you're not better in a few days, see a doctor.
lines.zh: 这个茶比较温和。睡前三十分钟喝。如果几天还不好，去看医生。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: That's helpful. I'll take both. Thanks.
lines.zh: 很有用。两样我都要。谢谢。

whereZh: 药店柜台前，你拿着医生的建议或要买常见的感冒药。

sounds.title: something / three / thirty
sounds.note: something、three、thirty 都有 th。数字听错会出问题，一定要听清 three 和 thirty。
sounds.example: Have it thirty minutes before bed.

sounds.title: pills / days / medicine
sounds.note: days、pills 的词尾是浊音 /z/。medicine 里的 s 更接近 /s/ 或 /z/，不要吞掉。
sounds.example: If you're not better in a few days, see a doctor.

variations.setupZh: 你要的那种止痛药没有了。
variations.cue: We're out of that one. This one is similar, but you should take it with food.
variations.cueZh: 那种没货了。这个差不多，不过要跟着饭吃。
hints: Okay, I'll take this one.
How is it different?
That's fine. With food, right?

variations.setupZh: 药师说得比较快，你想再确认一次。
variations.cue: So that's one tablet every six hours, not more than three a day, and not with other pain pills.
variations.cueZh: 就是每六小时一片，一天不超过三片，而且不要和其他止痛药一起吃。
hints: Sorry, could you repeat that?
One every six hours, no more than three a day.
And I shouldn't mix it with other pain pills, right?

variations.setupZh: 结账时药师很快问保险。
variations.cue: Do you have a pharmacy card, or will you pay full price today?
variations.cueZh: 您有药店会员卡或保险卡吗，还是今天按原价付？
hints: I'll pay full price today.
I don't have it with me.
Sorry, I missed that. Could you say it again?

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你去药店买什么、药师问了你什么、你要怎么服药。

phrases.text: What can I do for you?
Have you taken anything already today?
phrases.zh: 你今天已经吃过什么药了吗？

phrases.text: Are you on any other medicine?
Don't take it on an empty stomach.
phrases.note: 用法里最要紧的限制之一。

phrases.text: How often can I take it?
Every six hours, and no more than three times a day.
phrases.zh: 每六小时一次，一天最多三次。

phrases.text: Is there something gentle I can try?
phrases.zh: 有没有温和一点的可以试试？
phrases.note: 想要副作用更小的选择时用。

phrases.text: If you're not better in a few days, see a doctor.
phrases.zh: 如果几天还不好，去看医生。
phrases.note: 听清什么情况下要再就医。

whoZh: 你是 Leo，对面是药师 Jen。
goalZh: 说明需求，问清用法和要注意的事，顺利把药买走。
gistZh: 利奥去药店买缓解头痛和睡眠差的药，药师问了他是否在吃别的药，并交代了用法。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say what you needed and how you should take the medicine.

title: Booking an appointment by phone

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hello, Bright Clinic, this is Amy.
lines.zh: 您好，Bright 诊所，我是 Amy。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Hi Amy, I'd like to make an appointment, please.
lines.zh: 嗨 Amy，我想预约一个时间。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Of course. Is this for a regular checkup, or something else?
lines.zh: 当然可以。是常规检查，还是别的事情？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: A regular checkup. I'm free after three next week.
lines.zh: 常规检查。我下周下午三点以后都有空。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I have Wednesday at three thirty, or Friday at four.
lines.zh: 周三三点半有号，或者周五四点。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Wednesday at three thirty works for me.
lines.zh: 周三三点半可以。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Great. Can I get your name?
lines.zh: 好。请问怎么称呼？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Maya Wang. That's W-A-N-G.
lines.zh: Maya Wang，姓是 W-A-N-G。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Thanks, Maya. Please come fifteen minutes early.
lines.zh: 谢谢，Maya。请提前十五分钟到。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I will. Do I need to bring anything?
lines.zh: 好的。需要带什么吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Just your ID. We'll see you on Wednesday.
lines.zh: 带上证件就行。周三见。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Perfect. Thanks for your help. Bye.
lines.zh: 太好了。谢谢，再见。

whereZh: 你打电话给诊所或理发店预约一个时间。

sounds.title: three / thirty / Thursday? Wednesday
sounds.note: three 和 thirty 只差一个音节。三点 和 三点半听错会约错。Wednesday 的 d 常常几乎听不到。
sounds.example: Wednesday at three thirty works for me.

sounds.title: make an appointment / after three
sounds.note: make an appointment、after three 会连在一起。an 很轻。
sounds.example: I'd like to make an appointment, please.

variations.setupZh: 对方说周三已经满了。
variations.cue: Wednesday is full, but I can do Thursday at three thirty or Friday morning.
variations.cueZh: 周三已经满了，周四三点半或周五上午都可以。
hints: Thursday at three thirty, please.
Friday morning works. What time?
Is there anything earlier next week?

variations.setupZh: 你约好之后，需要改时间。
variations.cue: Sure, I can help you change it. What day works better?
variations.cueZh: 当然可以帮您改。哪一天更方便？
hints: Could we move it to Friday?
I'm free after four tomorrow.
Sorry, I can't make Wednesday anymore.

variations.setupZh: 你第一次没打通，语音留言很快。
variations.cue: You've reached Bright Clinic. Leave your name and number and we'll call you back this afternoon.
variations.cueZh: 这里是 Bright 诊所。请留下姓名和电话，我们今天下午会给您回拨。
hints: Hi, this is Maya Wang. My number is… Please call me back.
I need to book a checkup. Please call me this afternoon.
This is Maya. I'll try again later.

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你打电话约什么、对方给了哪些时间、你最后定在哪一天、还要带什么。

phrases.text: I'd like to make an appointment, please.
I'm free after three next week.
phrases.zh: 我下周下午三点以后都有空。
phrases.note: 先给一个时间范围，方便对方安排。

phrases.text: I have Wednesday at three thirty, or Friday at four.
phrases.zh: 周三三点半有号，或者周五四点。

phrases.text: Wednesday at three thirty works for me.
Can I get your name?
Please come fifteen minutes early.
Do I need to bring anything?
We'll see you on Wednesday.

whoZh: 你是 Maya，对面是前台 Amy。
goalZh: 说清要预约什么、给出可以的时间，并确认日期、地点和注意事项。
gistZh: 玛雅打电话预约下周三下午，前台给了两个时间供选择，最后确认了她的名字和到店时间。
microPromptEn: In one minute, say what you booked and when you need to arrive.

title: Introducing yourself

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Mark.
lines.zh: 嗨，我们好像还没见过。我是 Mark。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Mark. I'm Maya. I work on the tools team.
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你，Mark。我是 Maya，在工具组。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Oh, nice. I just joined the design team last week.
lines.zh: 哦，好。我上周刚加入设计组。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Welcome. How's your first week going?
lines.zh: 欢迎。第一周过得怎么样？

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: A little busy, but people have been really kind. What are you working on these days?
lines.zh: 有点忙，不过大家都挺好。你最近在做什么？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: We're making a small tool that helps people write faster. It's still early.
lines.zh: 我们在做一个小工具，帮大家写得更快。现在还早。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: That sounds useful. I'd love to see it sometime.
lines.zh: 听起来很有用。有机会想看看。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Sure. I can show you after lunch one day. Do you have a favorite lunch spot yet?
lines.zh: 当然。哪天午饭后我可以给你看一下。你有喜欢的午饭地方了吗？

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Not yet. I usually just grab a sandwich.
lines.zh: 还没有。我通常就随便买个三明治。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: There's a good place downstairs. I can show you tomorrow if you like.
lines.zh: 楼下有一家不错。你愿意的话，我明天可以带你去。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: That would be great. Thanks, Maya.
lines.zh: 那太好了。谢谢你，Maya。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Of course. It's really good to meet you.
lines.zh: 应该的。真高兴认识你。

whereZh: 一次小型见面会的开始，你要向新同事做个简短自我介绍。

sounds.title: meet / these / still
sounds.titleZh: meet 和 still 的长短
sounds.note: meet、team 偏长；still、this、it 是短音。Nice to meet you 不要把 meet 念短。
sounds.example: Nice to meet you, Mark.

sounds.title: nice to meet you / these days
sounds.note: Nice to meet you、these days 会连起来。to 很轻。
sounds.example: What are you working on these days?

roles.name: Maya

variations.cueZh: 抱歉，是 Maya 吗？你刚说是哪个组？
hints: Yes, Maya. I work on the tools team.
Maya, like the name. I'm on the tools team.
That's right. Tools team.

variations.setupZh: 聊完后对方提议加一下联系方式。

Sure, I'll give you my number.
I'll send you a message after this.

variations.setupZh: 又过来一个人，Mark 很快把你介绍给对方。

Hi Dana, good to meet you.
Sorry, I didn't catch your name.

microPromptZh: 用一分钟讲：你认识了谁、你怎么介绍自己、你们接下来可能做什么。

phrases.text: I don't think we've met. I'm Mark.

phrases.text: Nice to meet you. I work on the tools team.

phrases.note: 给出一个轻松的下一步。

phrases.text: It's really good to meet you.

whoZh: 你是 Maya，对面是新同事 Mark。
goalZh: 用自然的话说出你是谁、做什么、最近在忙什么，并问对方一句。
gistZh: 玛雅和新同事马克互相介绍，聊了各自在做的事和一个轻松的兴趣，然后去拿咖啡。

title: Chatting about the weekend

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Any plans for the weekend?
lines.zh: 周末有什么计划吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Not many. I might go for a walk if the weather's good. What about you?
lines.zh: 不多。天气好的话我可能去走走。你呢？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I might just stay in and catch up on sleep. I've been so tired this week.
lines.zh: 我可能就待在家里补觉。这周实在太累了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: That sounds nice, actually. I need more rest too.

lines.zh: 你要去什么好玩的地方吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Maybe the park near the river. It's quiet on Saturday morning.
lines.zh: 也许去河边那个公园。周六早上比较安静。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I heard it might rain on Saturday.
lines.zh: 我听说周六可能下雨。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Then maybe I'll just get lunch with my sister.
lines.zh: 那也许我就和姐姐吃个午饭。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: That still sounds pretty good. Tell me how it goes.
lines.zh: 那样也挺不错。回头告诉我怎么样。

lines.speaker: Leo

lines.zh: 会的。希望你能好好休息。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Thanks. Have a good one.
lines.zh: 谢谢。周末愉快。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: You too. See you Monday.
lines.zh: 你也是。周一见。

It was nice for a bit, then it rained.
Pretty good. How was your rest?

title: Inviting someone to dinner

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Hey Nina, it's good to see you. How have you been?
lines.zh: 嘿 Nina，见到你真好。你最近怎么样？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Pretty good, just busy. It's been a while!
lines.zh: 还不错，就是忙。好久没见了！

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: It has. I was wondering if you'd like to get dinner this week.
lines.zh: 是啊。我想问问你这周要不要一起吃晚饭。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I'd like that. What day were you thinking?
lines.zh: 好啊。你想哪一天？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: How about Thursday night? There's a new noodle place near work.
lines.zh: 周四晚上怎么样？公司附近新开了一家面馆。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Thursday is a bit hard. I have a late call.
lines.zh: 周四有点难，我晚上有个会。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: No problem. What about Friday?
lines.zh: 没关系。那周五呢？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Friday works. Want to meet at seven?
lines.zh: 周五可以。七点见好吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Seven is perfect. Should I book a table?
lines.zh: 七点正好。要不要我先订位？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Yes, please. I'll try not to be late.
lines.zh: 麻烦你了。我会尽量不迟到。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: If anything changes, just text me.
lines.zh: 如果有变化，给我发个消息就行。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: I will. Looking forward to it.
lines.zh: 会的。很期待。

whereZh: 你想请一位最近没见的同事或朋友吃饭。

sounds.title: wondering / week / works

variations.setupZh: 妮娜对那家面馆不大熟，想换一个。

Sure, there's a quiet cafe nearby too.

variations.setupZh: 约定当天，妮娜发消息说会晚到。

Got it. See you tomorrow at seven.
Sorry, can I call you? I didn't catch the last part.

title: Giving a small gift

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Hey, before I forget, I got you a little something.
lines.zh: 嘿，趁我还没忘，我给你带了点小东西。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Oh, you didn't have to do that.
lines.zh: 哎呀，你不用这样的。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: It's just some tea. You said you wanted to try this kind.
lines.zh: 只是一点茶。你说过想试试这种。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: That's so thoughtful. Thank you, Leo. Can I open it now?
lines.zh: 你想得真周到。谢谢你，利奥。我现在可以打开吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Of course. I hope you like it.
lines.zh: 当然。希望你会喜欢。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: It smells great. You really didn't need to, but I'm glad you did.
lines.zh: 味道真好。你真的不用特地准备，不过我很高兴你这么做了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I'm happy you like it. It wasn't a big thing.
lines.zh: 你喜欢我就高兴。这也不是什么大礼物。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Well, it made my day. Let me make this next time we hang out.
lines.zh: 这真让我高兴。下次见面我来泡。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I'd like that. Maybe next week?
lines.zh: 好啊。也许下周？

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Yes. I'll text you. Thanks again.
lines.zh: 好。我给你发消息。再次谢谢。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: You're welcome. Happy birthday, by the way.
lines.zh: 不客气。对了，生日快乐。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Thank you. This was really kind.
lines.zh: 谢谢。你真的很贴心。

title: Chatting on the way home

lines.text: Finally done. That meeting ran so long.
lines.zh: 终于结束了。那个会开了好久。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I know. I thought it would be twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 就是。我还以为只要二十分钟。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Same. Are you heading home now?
lines.zh: 我也是。你现在回家吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yeah. I'll probably cook something simple. What about you?
lines.zh: 对。我可能随便做点简单的。你呢？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I'm going to the gym first, then I'll just eat later.
lines.zh: 我先去健身房，然后再吃。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Nice. I should do that more often.
lines.zh: 真好。我也该多去。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: You can come next time if you want. It's right by the station.
lines.zh: 下次你要来的话也可以。就在车站旁边。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Maybe I will. This week I'm pretty tired though.
lines.zh: 也许会。不过这周我还挺累的。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That's fair. Tomorrow should be lighter.
lines.zh: 可以理解。明天应该会轻松一点。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I hope so. This is my turn. I'll see you tomorrow.
lines.zh: 希望如此。我在这儿转。明天见。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: See you. Get some rest.
lines.zh: 明天见。好好休息。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: You too. Bye.
lines.zh: 你也是。再见。

title: Giving a standup update

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: All right, let's keep this short. Maya, do you want to go first?
lines.zh: 好，咱们长话短说。Maya，你先来？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Sure. I finished the draft last night. I'll send it out after this call.
lines.zh: 好。草稿我昨晚写完了，会后我就发出去。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Great. Any blockers?
lines.zh: 很好。有什么卡住的吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I still need the numbers from the other team. I emailed them yesterday.
lines.zh: 对方组的数字我还没拿到。昨天已经发过邮件了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Okay. Leo, can you help with that?
lines.zh: 好。Leo，你能帮忙跟一下吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: If Leo can poke them, that would help a lot.
lines.zh: 如果 Leo 能去催一下，那就太好了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Leo's nodding, so let's do that. Maya, anything else?
lines.zh: Leo 点头了，那就这样。Maya，还有别的吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's all from me. Today I'll clean up the notes.
lines.zh: 我这边就这些。今天我会把记录整理一下。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Perfect. Let's talk again if anything gets stuck.
lines.zh: 很好。要是再卡住，我们再聊。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Sounds good. Thanks, everyone.
lines.zh: 好。谢谢大家。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Thanks, Maya. I'll move us along.
lines.zh: 谢谢 Maya。我继续往下。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay.
lines.zh: 好的。

Yes. We can move the other work to next week.

hints: That's right. I'll message the group.
Yes. I'll send the new date today.
Got it.

title: Talking through a change

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Thanks for looking at this. What did you think?
lines.zh: 谢谢你看这个。你觉得怎么样？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Overall it looks good. The first part is really clear.
lines.zh: 整体看起来不错。第一部分写得很清楚。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I'm glad. Was anything confusing?
lines.zh: 那就好。有没有什么地方让人困惑？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Just one thing. This sentence is a bit long, so I had to read it twice.
lines.zh: 就一件。这句有点长，我读了两遍才明白。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Oh, I see. I was trying to put too much in one place.
lines.zh: 哦，我明白了。我是想在一处塞太多东西。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: If you split it into two short lines, I think it will be easier.
lines.zh: 如果你拆成两句短的，我觉得会更好懂。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: That's a good idea. Anything else before I change it?
lines.zh: 好主意。我改之前还有别的吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's all. The rest is easy to follow.
lines.zh: 就这些。其余都很好跟。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Great. I'll change that now and send it back.
lines.zh: 好。我现在就改，然后再发给你。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: No rush. I can look again after lunch.
lines.zh: 不急。午饭后我可以再看一眼。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Thanks, Maya. This kind of note really helps.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，Maya。这种提醒真的有帮助。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Anytime. You did the hard part already.
lines.zh: 随时可以。难的部分你已经做完了。

That's all, really.
Just this word. 'Start' might be clearer than this one.

variations.setupZh: 利奥改完后很快回一句。

hints: Great, I'll look after lunch.

Nice work. I'll reply later.

phrases.zh: 这句有点长，我读了两遍才明白。
phrases.note: 把问题说具体，不攻击人。

phrases.text: If you split it into two short lines, I think it will be easier.
phrases.zh: 如果拆成两句短的，会更好懂。
phrases.note: 给出一个可执行的建议。

title: A short follow-up after a meeting

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Hey, have you got two minutes? I just want to lock the next steps.
lines.zh: 嘿，有两分钟吗？我只是想把下一步定下来。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Sure. I think I'm sending the note today, right?
lines.zh: 当然。我是今天把说明发出去，对吧？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Yes. And I'll give you a new date tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 对。我明天早上给你一个新的日期。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That works. Is there anything you need in the note?
lines.zh: 可以。说明里需要特别写什么吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Just the reason we're starting small, in plain words.
lines.zh: 只要用简单的话写明我们为什么先做小的。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay. I'll keep it to half a page.
lines.zh: 好。我会控制在半页以内。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Perfect. If anything changes, let's text each other.
lines.zh: 很好。如果有变化，我们就互相发消息。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Agreed. I'll also copy Sam so he isn't surprised.
lines.zh: 同意。我也会抄送 Sam，免得他感到突然。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Good idea. Thanks for staying after the meeting.
lines.zh: 好主意。谢谢你会后再留一下。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Of course. I didn't want this to get lost.
lines.zh: 应该的。我也不希望这事被忘掉。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Same. I'll talk to you tomorrow.
lines.zh: 彼此彼此。明天再聊。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Talk then.
lines.zh: 到时聊。

title: Showing a small feature

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I can show you the new button in two minutes. It helps you start a note faster.
lines.zh: 我可以两分钟给你看这个新按钮。它能让你更快开始写笔记。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Sure, I'm watching. Where do I find it?
lines.zh: 好，我看着。它在哪里？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: It's at the top, next to save. You just click it once.
lines.zh: 在最上面，保存旁边。点一下就行。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Okay. What happens after I click?
lines.zh: 好。点完之后会怎样？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: It gives you three simple starters. You pick one and then write.
lines.zh: 它会给你三个简单的开头。你选一个，然后接着写。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: That's neat. Can I change the starter if I don't like it?
lines.zh: 挺巧的。如果我不喜欢那个开头，能换吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes. Just click again and pick another one. Nothing is saved yet.
lines.zh: 能。再点一下，换一个就行。这时还没有保存。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Nice. Will this work on my phone too?
lines.zh: 很好。我手机上也能用吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Not yet. That's the next step. For now it's only on the computer.
lines.zh: 还不能。那是下一步。现在只在电脑上。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Okay, that's fine. Can I try it later today?
lines.zh: 没关系。我今天晚些能试试吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Please do. If anything feels strange, just tell me.
lines.zh: 请试。如果有哪里别扭，直接告诉我。

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: I will. Thanks for the clear walk-through.
lines.zh: 我会的。谢谢你讲得这么清楚。

title: Hearing from a user

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Thanks for making time. I just want to hear how you use this.
lines.zh: 谢谢你抽时间。我只是想听听你是怎么用这个的。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Sure. I use it almost every morning to start my notes.
lines.zh: 当然。我几乎每天早上都用它来开始写笔记。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: That's helpful. What's easy about it?
lines.zh: 这很有用。你觉得哪儿容易？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Once I get going, writing is fine. The hard part is the first minute.
lines.zh: 一旦开始写，后面还好。难的是最开始那一分钟。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: So the first minute feels slow. What do you usually do then?
lines.zh: 也就是说，第一分钟会觉得慢。那时候你通常怎么办？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I wait, or I open an old note and copy a little. It feels messy.
lines.zh: 我会等，或者打开一篇旧的，抄一点。感觉挺乱的。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: If we made the first step faster, would that help?
lines.zh: 如果我们把第一步变快，会有帮助吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Yes, a lot. I don't need more buttons. I just need to start sooner.
lines.zh: 会，很有帮助。我不需要更多按钮。我只是想更快开始。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Got it. Just to make sure I'm following: starting is hard, and more buttons wouldn't help.
lines.zh: 明白了。我确认一下：难的是开始，多加按钮没有帮助。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: That's exactly it. Thanks for asking.
lines.zh: 完全正确。谢谢你问这些。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Thank you. This is really useful. I'll share a short summary with you later.
lines.zh: 谢谢你。这非常有用。稍后我会把一段短摘要分享给你。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I'd like that. Happy to talk again if you need.

title: Working across time zones

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Hi Emma, I need about thirty minutes with you this week.
lines.zh: 嗨 Emma，这周我需要和你谈大约三十分钟。

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Sure. What's your local time? I always get mixed up.
lines.zh: 当然。你那边是什么时间？我经常搞混。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: I'm eight hours ahead of you. Morning for me is evening for you.
lines.zh: 我比你早八个小时。我这边的早上是你那边的晚上。

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Right. I can do Wednesday at eight in the evening my time.
lines.zh: 对。我这边周三晚上八点可以。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: That's Thursday morning at nine for me. That works.
lines.zh: 那就是我这边周四上午九点。可以。

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Great. Thirty minutes is enough, right?
lines.zh: 好。三十分钟够吧？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Yes. I'll send a calendar note with both times on it.
lines.zh: 够。我会发一个日历，上面写上两边的时间。

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Please do. I don't want to miss it.
lines.zh: 请发。我可不想错过。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: If something comes up, let's move it, not cancel.
lines.zh: 如果有事，我们就改期，不要取消。

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Agreed. Looking forward to it.
lines.zh: 同意。很期待。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Me too. I'll send the note in a minute.
lines.zh: 我也是。我马上把日程发出去。

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Thanks, Leo. Talk Thursday.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，利奥。周四聊。

lines.zh: 我想分享一个我们刚做完的小东西。它能帮你更快开始写。

lines.speaker: Nina
lines.text: Nice. Who is it for?
lines.zh: 不错。它是给谁用的？

title: A job interview

lines.text: Thanks for coming in, Maya. To start, could you tell me a bit about yourself?
lines.zh: 谢谢你来，Maya。先请你简单介绍一下自己。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Sure. I work on tools that help people write and build things. Lately I've been making those tools easier to start.
lines.zh: 好。我做帮助大家写作和把事情做出来的工具。最近我在让这些工具更容易开始用。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's interesting. Can you give me one example?

lines.speaker: Maya

lines.zh: 我们有一个一开始显得空空的页面。我加了三个简单开头，让大家能更快开始。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: How did you know that was the right thing to do?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道这样做是对的？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I asked a few people how they used it. Most of them got stuck in the first minute.
lines.zh: 我问了几个人他们怎么用。大多数人卡在最开始的一分钟。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: What would you do differently next time?
lines.zh: 如果再做一次，你会有什么不同？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I'd talk to users even earlier, before we built anything.
lines.zh: 我会更早和用户聊，在还没开始做之前。

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's a good answer. Do you have a question for me?
lines.zh: 答得很好。你有什么想问我的吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes. How does the team usually share work and give feedback?
lines.zh: 有。你们团队通常怎么分工、怎么给反馈？

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: We keep it simple: short notes, and a weekly talk. I can say more later.
lines.zh: 我们保持简单：短说明，再加一周一次的交流。稍后我可以再多说一点。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That sounds like a good way to work. Thank you.

title: Looking at an apartment

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: This is the living room. The light is pretty good in the afternoon.
lines.zh: 这是客厅。下午的光线还不错。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: It is. Does the rent include wifi and water?
lines.zh: 是的。租金里含无线网和水费吗？

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: Wifi and water are included. Power is not.
lines.zh: 无线网和水费含了。电费不含。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Okay. Is there a desk? I work from home some days.
lines.zh: 好。有桌子吗？我有些天会在家办公。

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: There's a small desk by the window. I can show you.
lines.zh: 窗户边有一张小桌子。我可以带你看。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's just what I need. How soon could I move in?
lines.zh: 这正是我需要的。最早什么时候能入住？

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: The place is free from next Friday.
lines.zh: 下周五开始空出来。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I need a day to think about it. Can I write to you tomorrow?
lines.zh: 我需要一天时间考虑。我明天再写信给你可以吗？

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: Of course. I can hold it until tomorrow evening.
lines.zh: 当然可以。我可以帮你留到明天晚上。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thank you. I'll let you know either way.
lines.zh: 谢谢。无论行不行，我都会告诉你。

lines.speaker: Brian
lines.text: Sounds good. Any other questions while we're here?
lines.zh: 好。趁我们还在，还有别的问题吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's all for now. Thanks for showing me around.
lines.zh: 暂时就这些。谢谢你带我看房。

title: A simple visit to the bank

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Hello, how can I help you today?
lines.zh: 您好，今天有什么可以帮您？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Hi. I'm here to ask about a refund. It hasn't arrived yet.
lines.zh: 嗨。我来问一笔退款。到现在还没到账。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I can look that up. May I see your ID, please?
lines.zh: 我可以帮您查。请出示一下证件。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Here it is. It should be from last Friday.
lines.zh: 给您。应该是上周五那笔。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Yes, I see it. It's still being processed. It should arrive in three days.
lines.zh: 我看到了。还在处理中。大概三天内会到。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Okay. Is there anything I need to do?
lines.zh: 好。我还需要做什么吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Not right now. I can print a short note for you.
lines.zh: 现在不用。我可以给您打一张简短说明。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: Yes, please. If it still doesn't come, should I come back?
lines.zh: 请帮我打一份。如果还是没到，我还要再来吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You can call us first. The number is on the note.
lines.zh: 可以先打电话。电话在这张单子上。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: That's helpful. Thanks for checking.
lines.zh: 这很有用。谢谢你帮我查。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You're welcome. Is there anything else?
lines.zh: 不客气。还有别的事吗？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.text: That's all. Have a good day.
lines.zh: 没有了。祝你今天愉快。

title: Saying no to extra work, politely

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Maya, could you take this small thing this week? It shouldn't take long.
lines.zh: Maya，这周你能接这个小事情吗？应该花不了太久。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thanks for thinking of me. I want to be honest: this week is already full.
lines.zh: 谢谢你想到我。我想实话实说：这周已经排满了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Oh, I didn't realize. Is there any way you could squeeze it in?
lines.zh: 哦，我不知道。有没有办法再挤一挤？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: If I take it now, the thing I already promised will slip. I don't want that to happen.
lines.zh: 如果我现在接，我已经答应的那件会延期。我不希望那样。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That makes sense. What if it's just a short look, not the whole thing?
lines.zh: 有道理。如果只是看一眼，不是全部做完呢？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I can look at a short note tomorrow, but I can't build it this week.
lines.zh: 我明天可以看一份短说明，但这周做不了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That's already helpful. Could we plan it for next week instead?
lines.zh: 这就已经有帮助了。那我们改到下周可以吗？

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes. Put it on Monday, and I'll tell you then if I can take it.
lines.zh: 可以。放到周一，到时我会告诉你能不能接。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Okay. Thanks for being clear. I'd rather know now.
lines.zh: 好。谢谢你说得清楚。我宁愿现在知道。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Of course. I just don't want to say yes and then let you down.
lines.zh: 应该的。我只是不想先答应，后来又让你失望。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I appreciate that. I'll send the note this afternoon.
lines.zh: 我很感谢这样。我下午把说明发来。

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I'll read it tomorrow. Talk soon.
lines.zh: 我明天看。回头再聊。
